judgment.summary: Directional locks across the chest, legs, paws, tail, crown, ears, and muzzle break up the primitive contours and produce the first complete cover-driven digital candidate.
judgment.next_highest_impact_gap: Increase contrapposto and leg mass while improving fur, leather-edge, and hard-surface finish; the full candidate is coherent but remains too upright and procedurally faceted for the 85-point target.
